title: CreoleVal: Multilingual Multitask Benchmarks for Creoles
reasoning: The paper primarily introduces and evaluates benchmark datasets for Creole languages in NLP tasks. While it uses religious texts as a data source for machine translation and briefly discusses ethical considerations and data quality concerns related to such texts in its limitations section, it does not have a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as its main research focus.
